brief.objective: Minimise closest Lady distance squared plus 1e6/(closest Guard distance + 0.1) within 240 s, never letting the Guard inside 5 m. Lady miss distance dominates the score, so close aggressively on the Lady, and spend Guard margin only to avoid capture.
brief.approach: Accelerate along-track toward the Lady early, using the full 240 s; about 11 m/s average is needed to cover 2600 m. Build an early radial offset so the pass around the Guard is lateral rather than head-on. When the Guard is within about 250 m and the combined closing rate is high, switch to EVADE_GUARD to sidestep around it toward the Lady, then resume APPROACH_LADY as soon as the Guard is behind or opening. Inside 300 m, follow the braking glide slope to reach 5 m, keep a fuel reserve for the terminal brake and last-second evasion, and avoid long BRAKE or HOLD phases that let the advanced Guard catch up.
phases: T0-20s: APPROACH_LADY at full along-track thrust while adding radial offset (about 1 m/s radial) to open a lateral lane past the Guard
Transit: APPROACH_LADY capped at 18 m/s and keep the radial offset; COAST when at speed to save fuel
Guard pass: EVADE_GUARD whenever the Guard is under 250 m and closing, sidestepping radially around it toward the Lady and never letting it inside 60 m
Post-pass: APPROACH_LADY immediately once the Guard is behind or its range is opening
Terminal: inside 300 m of the Lady, brake along the glide slope to 2 m/s and close to under 5 m; EVADE_GUARD only if the Guard is under 60 m
Fallback: if the Lady is unreachable before 240 s, keep closing on the Lady anyway and use HOLD_STANDOFF only if the Guard threatens capture
